scripts.db:tables: docker exec infra-vintage-db-1 mysql -h127.0.0.1 -ueco -peco ecologikal -e 'SHOW TABLES;'
scripts.db:stats: docker exec infra-vintage-db-1 mysql -h127.0.0.1 -ueco -peco ecologikal -e "SELECT 'miembros' t, COUNT(*) n FROM miembros UNION ALL SELECT 'ecocenters', COUNT(*) FROM ecocenters UNION ALL SELECT 'place', COUNT(*) FROM place UNION ALL SELECT 'idea', COUNT(*) FROM idea UNION ALL SELECT 'member_skills', COUNT(*) FROM member_skills UNION ALL SELECT 'messages', COUNT(*) FROM messages;"
